correctness.rationale: Exact lift and monodromy multiplication establish trace 1-2(a+b)h+abh² and determinant abh². The three strict Schur inequalities factor exactly, yielding an if-and-only-if stability ceiling including equality/beyond. Before the first coalescence the larger positive eigenvalue is strictly decreasing; beyond it the determinant lower bound grows strictly, proving a unique global spectral optimum. A nonzero offdiagonal proves the critical eigenvalue defective. Simultaneous diagonalization proves all commuting SPD dimensions; the checker reproduces 80 exact rational identities and sampled spectra, without treating finite tests as proof.

The unique scalar critical-damping choice explicitly identifies rate-optimal tuning and its nonsemisimple transient; the exact difference between stability and finite-horizon performance matters for algorithm selection. This is a natural complete small-sample classification, not an arbitrary numerical instance.
